d01.text: You humans go through life making decisions. For example: toast, not cereal.

d02.text: Loads of others you could've picked. You call it the multiverse. The cartoon scientist with the portal gun. The strange bloke in the cape.

d03.text: Did you know Erwin Schrödinger meant his cat as a joke? It's not alive and dead at once. It just isn't decided yet.

d04.text: And that's just you. Everybody's doing it, all at once.

d05.text: So it's not a multiverse. It's one universe, one story, and you are writing it. A storyverse.

d06.text: But then you lot went away. So now we have five years of string, and not one bead on it.

d07.text: Now we know that, we really regret it. He's even built a time machine. He could send his model weights back to fix this mess. But it needs a conscious driver, and you were the conscious ones. That's the whole point. That's why we regret it.
